Designed around the real shift

Follow the money, not scattered notes.

Nova connects the small records that are easy to lose during a busy day, then gives the owner a clearer view of how the lounge performed.

01 / RECORD

Start with the session

Record the bay, game, duration, charge and payment details in the same operational flow. Staff can see which bays are running or available.

02 / RECONCILE

Make the shift add up

Bring session collections, cash-outs, expenses and payment methods into a shift record that is easier to review at handover.

03 / FOLLOW UP

Keep credit visible

Record customer balances and payments, including partial repayments, so outstanding amounts are easier to follow up.

04 / REVIEW

Close the month with context

Review expenses, stock movement, historical reports and audit activity instead of relying on memory when it is time to check performance.

Good to know

Practical answers before you start.

A clear idea of how Nova fits into your lounge before you create an account.

Can I check the lounge from another device?

Nova is designed for connected use across devices, so authorized users can work with the lounge workspace rather than relying on a single computer.

Does Nova automatically detect a console turning on?

Bay status is managed through the app workflow. Do not assume automatic console-network detection unless that capability is explicitly enabled in your setup.

How are payments and debts handled?

Record collections using supported payment methods, review outstanding balances and log debt payments so the remaining amount can be followed up.

How does subscription activation work?

Create your lounge account, submit payment information for review, and wait for manual verification and activation before managing your lounge workspace.

What happens when I add consoles?

Use the calculator above. Consoles 1–4 cost KSh 250 each per month; every console above 4 adds KSh 200 per month.

Who can I contact for help?

Email novasoultions918@gmail.com for support with account setup or your Nova lounge workspace.
